newsitem.title: UK: Iran buys three cargoes February white sugar-trade.
newsitem.headline: Iran buys three cargoes February white sugar-trade.

text.p: Iran bought three cargoes of Thai and European Union (EU) origin white sugar for shipment in February, traders said on Friday. Iran bought one Thai cargo at $322 per tonne, FOB, and two EU cargoes at $318 and $317, they said.
Details of the suppliers have yet to emerge.
Physical brokers said the purchases formed part of Iran's regular buying programme at this time of year, and that the prices were low.
"It's nothing special at all -- they've been buying on and off for the past few months," said one.
"They're looking for first quarter cargoes...and are being quite aggressive about prices," he said.
